reference.floor_definition: errors at Gamma = gamma_ref (the reference's own per-bin mean force): e_Fp = 0 by construction (no deterministic floor), e_F = the mean-force-route vs density-route consistency of the reference; none is a lower bound
reference.estimator: Gamma = M/max(C,1) (0 where C=0) from (M_prod, C_prod) once C_prod has any count else (M_all, C_all); F = histogram_pmf(Gamma)

tv_floor.method: exact: (K/2) E|X/N - 1/K|, X ~ Bin(N, 1/K), K = 18 (each bin is marginally binomial)

definitions.G: (X_FR - X_ABF) / X_ABF per seed (same N, same seed); median, seed bootstrap 95 % CI, wins = G < 0
definitions.tau: first save after which the metric stays <= eps at every later save (all saves of the run); inf (JSON 'inf') = censored.  Paired at one N (both arms share the grid).
definitions.tau_bgrid: the same on the COMMON budget grid only (200 uniform + 24 log-spaced u, identical at every N); used whenever tau is compared ACROSS N (best allocation, budget-axis tau vs N)
definitions.tau_rank: FR wins when tau_FR < tau_ABF (finite beats censored; censored vs censored ties); exact sign test.  A tau whose threshold lies below a hard reference floor (threshold_floors, unreachable_by_construction) is censored in every arm by construction: its ties are not evidence of equivalence
definitions.threshold_floors: zero-noise floor of each error (the scorer fed the exact bin-averaged reference); gateway e_F' and e_F'_em: HARD lower bound 0.0323 (within-bin variation of F'_ref, e^2 = stat^2 + floor^2), so the frozen strict threshold 0.012 is unreachable by construction and mid 0.035 needs a statistical part <= 0.0136; Ibar_Fp_stat / final_e_Fp_stat are the labelled floor-free companions (RMS of Gamma - bin-averaged F'_ref), descriptive, not frozen metrics
definitions.Ibar: mean of the error over the 200 uniform budget fractions u = k/200
definitions.TV_half: TV(18 coarse bins) of C_all(t) - C_all(s_lo), s_lo = save nearest t/2 (or the run start)
definitions.TV_inst_floor: E_N[TV] under multinomial(N, uniform 18), exact binomial formula
definitions.establishment: first save after which the instantaneous far-state fraction stays >= 0.5 x target (frozen); ill-defined at N <= 2 (est_cum_*: the same on the cumulative visitation C_all)
definitions.establishment_null: null calibration on each N's save grid: far count ~ Bin(N, target) independently per save (an EXACTLY uniform population); est_unreliable = N <= 2 or P(no failure among the saves with u > 1/2) < 0.9: there est_* is censored / late by chance even when established; read est_cum_* and first arrival instead.  Uniform-target FR birth-death clones into the under-filled far state and kills over-represented walkers, which can push the instantaneous count BELOW binomial scatter: at unreliable N an FR establishment advantage is NOT evidence for faster convergence (Outcome C)
definitions.fr_events: realised deaths (= realised replacements, one death + one copy) per FR opportunity in BOTH systems; gateway from fr_deaths_hist / fr_opp_death_cum (engine /2), its capped candidates kd + kc reported separately as fr_candidate*; fr_activity: FR arms with zero realised deaths equal ABF (LTA: bitwise), so their G = 0 is FR inactivity, not equivalence
definitions.fr_cap_extension: LTA only: cap max(1, floor(0.02 N)) where the historical int(0.02 N) is 0 (N < 50); the gateway's max(1, floor(0.08 N)) is its historical rule (no extension)
definitions.best_allocation: min over N of the seed median (ABF all N, FR N >= 2); bootstrap resamples seeds per N (one draw shared by both methods) and re-selects the minimising N; ties share the credit (boot_tie_frac); an N without usable seeds in a resample is skipped (boot_frac_no_data when none is left); candidates.Ns_missing lists planned N absent from the candidate set (the minimum is then over a REDUCED ladder); tau via tau_bgrid
definitions.max_transient: (ABF - FR)/ABF of the seed-median curves over the 200 uniform u (seeds with both arms; n = 0: none)
